testcase.name: a did-key identity is refused rotation against the real registrar()
a published hold can be set and then actually cleared()
reporting a key stolen withdraws it from the published document()
a credential signed with the rotated key can actually be issued()
after rotation, new credentials are signed with the new key()
a hold on one credential does not disturb its neighbours in the list()
rotating a web identity mints a new key and keeps the old one published()
